caption: Journal Provenance
description: Agent Journal's provenance for a transformed or generated event. Invariant per-run facts (producer, capture time, contract hash) are stored once in run.json under shared and are reached through run_uid and contract_uid; they appear on an event only in a self-contained export.
name: journal_provenance

sequence.description: Journal's event sequence within the run; occurrence order, never clock order.

basis.description: Detail for the time basis (for example which preceding record supplied the fallback time).
